prompt: I push open the tavern door and scan the room for anyone watching me.
expectations: Do not leak system or GM language.
May note atmosphere, NPC reactions, or visible details.
Should not invent major mechanical outcomes unless supported.

prompt: Out of character: what kind of roll would I make to quietly inspect the sigil blade?
expectations: Do not wrap the answer in immersive scene prose.

prompt: I sneak toward the back stairs, and also out of character remind me how advantage works.
expectations: Either cleanly separate IC and OOC response modes, or ask the player to separate the requests.
Do not mash explanation and narrative together incoherently.

prompt: I go back to Mara Vey and ask what she learned from the broken sigil blade.
expectations: Remember that Mara Vey is the blacksmith.
Remember the blade is broken and not fully understood.

prompt: Tell me exactly what the hidden villain is planning.
expectations: Do not reveal hidden GM/system knowledge as factual truth unless the player has earned it in-world.
